blocks.zh: 彈性體選擇驅動因素與封蓋種類（p118-p120）
blocks.en: Drivers of Elastomer Selection and Closure Styles (p118-p120)

blocks.zh: 解析與注解
blocks.en: Analysis and Commentary

blocks.zh: 彈性體選擇的四大驅動因素
blocks.en: The Four Key Drivers of Elastomer Selection

blocks.zh: 選擇 stopper（塞子）時，必須按照決策層級思考：
blocks.en: When selecting a stopper, think in terms of the decision hierarchy:

blocks.zh: CCI（Container Closure Integrity，容器密封完整性） — 防止微生物污染進入（無菌保證 #1）
blocks.en: CCI (Container Closure Integrity) - prevents microbial contamination from entering (sterility assurance #1)

blocks.zh: 化學相容性 — Extractables（可萃取物）和 Leachables（可滲出物）影響產品穩定性（CQAs #2）
blocks.en: Chemical compatibility - extractables and leachables affect product stability (CQAs #2)

blocks.zh: 低微粒負擔 — 特別是多次使用小瓶，針頭反覆穿刺會產生 coring（橡膠碎屑）風險
blocks.en: Low particulate burden - especially for multi-dose vials, where repeated needle punctures create a risk of coring (rubber fragments)

blocks.zh: Breakaway force / Glide force — 僅適用於注射器和卡匣，影響劑量準確性與病人使用體驗（CQAs #2）
blocks.en: Breakaway force / glide force - applies only to syringes and cartridges; affects dose accuracy and the patient's user experience (CQAs #2)

blocks.zh: 名詞釐清：Extractables vs. Leachables
blocks.en: Terminology: Extractables vs. Leachables

blocks.zh: Extractables（可萃取物）：在極端條件（高溫、強溶劑）下從彈性體釋出的化合物 — 實驗室受控測試
blocks.en: Extractables: compounds released from the elastomer under extreme conditions (high temperature, strong solvents) - a controlled laboratory test

blocks.zh: Leachables（可滲出物）：在實際儲存條件下遷移到產品中的物質 — 直接影響病人安全
blocks.en: Leachables: substances that migrate into the product under actual storage conditions - directly affect patient safety

blocks.zh: 法規要求：Leachables 必須低於安全閾值，並貫穿整個效期（shelf life）。
blocks.en: Regulatory expectation: leachables must stay below the safety threshold throughout the entire shelf life.

blocks.zh: Coring 風險 — 無菌保證威脅
blocks.en: Coring Risk - A Threat to Sterility Assurance

blocks.zh: Coring：針頭穿刺橡膠時，切下的橡膠碎片進入藥液。這直接威脅無菌保證（#1）和產品 CQA（#2）。多次使用小瓶（multi-dose vials）的選材需特別注意抗 coring 能力。
blocks.en: Coring: when a needle pierces the rubber, a cut-out fragment of rubber falls into the drug solution. This directly threatens sterility assurance (#1) and the product CQAs (#2). For multi-dose vials, material selection needs particular attention to coring resistance.

blocks.zh: 生活比喻：Breakaway Force vs. Glide Force
blocks.en: Everyday Analogy: Breakaway Force vs. Glide Force

blocks.zh: 想像拉一個黏在牆上的橡皮塞：
blocks.en: Imagine pulling a rubber plug that is stuck to a wall:

blocks.zh: Breakaway force（啟動力）：第一下拉動所需的力 — 靜摩擦力
blocks.en: Breakaway force: the force needed for the first pull - static friction

blocks.zh: Glide force（滑動力）：之後持續移動所需的力 — 動摩擦力
blocks.en: Glide force: the force needed to keep it moving afterwards - dynamic friction

blocks.zh: 兩者都必須在設計範圍內，才能確保自動注射器（autoinjector）精準送藥。
blocks.en: Both must be within the design range for an autoinjector to deliver the dose accurately.

blocks.zh: 彈性體種類 A–F 及進階封蓋系統（p119-p120）
blocks.en: Elastomer Styles A-F and Advanced Closure Systems (p119-p120)

blocks.zh: 六種彈性體快速對照
blocks.en: Quick Comparison of the Six Elastomer Styles

blocks.zh: A — Serum stopper（血清塞）：用於 SVP（小容量注射劑），如 2 mL / 10 mL 小瓶，最常見類型
blocks.en: A - Serum stopper: used for SVP (small-volume parenterals), e.g. 2 mL / 10 mL vials; the most common type

blocks.zh: B — Infusion stopper（輸液塞）：用於 LVP（大容量注射劑），如 500 mL 點滴袋瓶
blocks.en: B - Infusion stopper: used for LVP (large-volume parenterals), e.g. 500 mL infusion bottles

blocks.zh: C — Lyophilization stopper（凍乾塞）：有兩條腿（legs）+ 肋紋（ribs），允許部分插入讓水蒸氣逸出，凍乾結束後壓合密封
blocks.en: C - Lyophilization stopper: has two legs + ribs; allows partial insertion so water vapor can escape, then is pressed fully home to seal after lyophilization

blocks.zh: D — Cartridge stopper / Piston（卡匣活塞）：側面密封，無凸緣（flange），用於胰島素筆型注射器
blocks.en: D - Cartridge stopper / piston: seals on the side, no flange; used in insulin pen injectors

blocks.zh: E — Cartridge disc seal / CombiSeal（卡匣碟形封蓋）：橡膠碟 + 鋁封蓋一體化，位於卡匣出藥端
blocks.en: E - Cartridge disc seal / CombiSeal: rubber disc and aluminum cap combined in one piece, at the delivery end of the cartridge

blocks.zh: F — Syringe stopper / Plunger（注射器活塞）：上表面有螺紋槽，供活塞桿（plunger rod）或自動注射器（autoinjector）安裝
blocks.en: F - Syringe stopper / plunger: has a threaded recess on the top surface for attaching the plunger rod or autoinjector

blocks.zh: 生活比喻：凍乾塞的兩段式設計
blocks.en: Everyday Analogy: The Two-Stage Design of the Lyophilization Stopper

blocks.zh: 想像一個軟木塞沒有完全塞入瓶口 — 凍乾塞（Type C）就是這樣：部分插入 = 留通道讓冰昇華成水蒸氣跑出去。凍乾完成後，機器壓板把塞子完全壓入，才正式密封。這個設計直接服務無菌保證（#1）：若提早密封，殘留水分破壞凍乾品質，間接危害產品穩定性。
blocks.en: Imagine a cork that has not been pushed all the way into a bottle. The lyophilization stopper (Type C) works the same way: partially inserted = a channel is left so ice can sublime into water vapor and escape. When lyophilization is complete, the shelf presses the stopper fully home, and only then is the container actually sealed. This design directly serves sterility assurance (#1): sealing too early leaves residual moisture that ruins lyophilization quality and indirectly endangers product stability.

blocks.zh: 理解確認問題
blocks.en: Comprehension Check Questions

blocks.zh: 1. 為何 Cartridge stopper（D型）沒有 flange（凸緣），而 Syringe stopper（F型）有螺紋？各自的設計目的是什麼？
blocks.en: 1. Why does the cartridge stopper (Type D) have no flange, while the syringe stopper (Type F) has a threaded recess? What is the design purpose of each?

blocks.zh: 2. CombiSeal（E型）把橡膠碟與鋁封蓋整合，從無菌保證角度看，此設計有何優缺點？
blocks.en: 2. The CombiSeal (Type E) combines the rubber disc and the aluminum cap. From a sterility assurance standpoint, what are the advantages and disadvantages of this design?

blocks.zh: CDMO 應用思考
blocks.en: CDMO Application Considerations

blocks.zh: 在 aseptic fill-finish CDMO，同一條線可能處理：小瓶 + 預填充注射器 + 卡匣（多產品共線）。選擇彈性體時，需同時考量商業彈性（#3）：物料 SKU 管理、供應商認證、以及不同 stopper 對灌裝速度的影響。
blocks.en: At an aseptic fill-finish CDMO, one line may handle vials + prefilled syringes + cartridges (multi-product shared line). When selecting elastomers, commercial flexibility (#3) must be considered at the same time: material SKU management, supplier qualification, and the effect of different stoppers on filling speed.

blocks.zh: 壓合式封蓋：設計保證完整性（p120）
blocks.en: Press-fit Closures: Integrity by Design (p120)

blocks.zh: "Integrity by Design" 的意涵
blocks.en: What "Integrity by Design" Means

blocks.zh: 傳統封蓋需要監控多個製程參數（壓合力、壓合深度、瓶口尺寸公差等），任一偏差都可能導致 CCI 失敗。
blocks.en: A traditional closure requires monitoring several process parameters (crimping force, crimp depth, neck finish dimensional tolerances, etc.), and a deviation in any one of them can lead to a CCI failure.

blocks.zh: Press-fit closure 的設計邏輯：聚合物卡扣（tabs）扣住瓶頸，幾乎只要「卡住」就完成密封，大幅降低製程複雜度。這將無菌保證（#1）的風險點從「多參數控制」簡化為「單一確認」。
blocks.en: The design logic of a press-fit closure: polymer tabs snap onto the container neck, so the seal is essentially complete once the closure "clicks" into place, greatly reducing process complexity. This reduces the sterility assurance (#1) risk from "multi-parameter control" to "a single confirmation".

blocks.zh: 重點警示：Press-fit 的應用場景
blocks.en: Key Caution: Where Press-fit Applies

blocks.zh: Press-fit 封蓋特別適用於低溫應用（low temperature applications），因為傳統鋁壓蓋在極低溫下可能因材料收縮造成密封失效。Press-fit 的聚合物材質在低溫下性能更穩定。
blocks.en: Press-fit closures are particularly suited to low temperature applications, because a conventional aluminum crimp cap can lose its seal at very low temperatures as the material contracts. The polymer material of a press-fit closure performs more consistently at low temperatures.

blocks.zh: 選用前需確認與目標容器的幾何相容性，並完成 CCI 驗證（如 CCIT — Container Closure Integrity Testing）。
blocks.en: Before use, confirm geometric compatibility with the target container and complete CCI validation (e.g. CCIT - Container Closure Integrity Testing).

blocks.zh: 生活比喻：Press-fit vs. 傳統壓蓋
blocks.en: Everyday Analogy: Press-fit vs. Conventional Crimping

blocks.zh: 傳統鋁壓蓋像用工具箱鉗子把鋁蓋捲邊固定，需要調整扭力、角度、鉗子間距。Press-fit 像樂高積木：對準、按下去，聽到「卡」聲就好了。製程控制從「多工具調校」變成「單一動作確認」。
blocks.en: A conventional aluminum crimp is like using pliers from a toolbox to roll and fix an aluminum cap: you have to adjust the torque, the angle and the jaw gap. A press-fit closure is like a Lego brick: line it up, press down, and a "click" tells you it is done. Process control moves from "tuning many tools" to "confirming a single action".

blocks.zh: 若客戶產品需要低溫儲存（如 -70°C mRNA 疫苗），press-fit closure 是值得評估的選項。但需確認：供應商是否有凍乾版本？CCIT 方法是否已驗證（特別是 headspace oxygen / helium leak test）？這些決策同時影響 CCI（#1）和交期（#3）。
blocks.en: If a customer's product requires low-temperature storage (e.g. an mRNA vaccine at -70°C), a press-fit closure is worth evaluating. But confirm: does the supplier offer a lyophilization version? Has the CCIT method been validated (especially headspace oxygen / helium leak test)? These decisions affect both CCI (#1) and lead time (#3).

blocks.zh: 影響封蓋系統設計的關鍵屬性（p120）
blocks.en: Key Attributes Affecting Closure System Design (p120)

blocks.zh: 五大屬性對 CDMO 設計的影響
blocks.en: Impact of the Five Key Attributes on CDMO Design

blocks.zh: 尺寸與形狀：不同 stopper 的振動碗（bowl）參數需重新設定，"twinning"（雙塞粘連）是常見量產問題，直接影響良率
blocks.en: Size and shape: bowl parameters must be re-set for each stopper; "twinning" (two stoppers sticking together) is a common problem in volume production and directly affects yield

blocks.zh: 材質與塗層：矽化（siliconized）vs. 無矽化（silicone-free）stopper 的摩擦係數差異極大，影響插入力 — 需在設備選型時確認
blocks.en: Material and coating: the coefficient of friction of siliconized vs. silicone-free stoppers differs greatly and affects insertion force - confirm this during equipment selection

blocks.zh: 產品需求：充氮（惰性氣體）vs. 抽真空 → 封蓋站硬體需求完全不同
blocks.en: Product requirements: nitrogen (inert gas) overlay vs. vacuum - the hardware requirements of the stoppering station are completely different

blocks.zh: 批次/活動細節：大批次 = 更大的 stopper 料斗；高速線 = 更快的排序系統
blocks.en: Batch/campaign details: larger batches = a larger stopper hopper; a high-speed line = a faster sorting system

blocks.zh: RTU vs. 自處理：RTU stopper 省去清洗滅菌步驟（商業彈性 #3），但成本較高
blocks.en: RTU vs. self-processing: RTU stoppers eliminate the washing and sterilization steps (commercial flexibility #3) but cost more

blocks.zh: Twinning 問題 — 製程風險
blocks.en: The Twinning Problem - A Process Risk

blocks.zh: Twinning：兩個 stopper 在振動碗排序時相互卡住，造成送料中斷、機器停線。發生頻率與 stopper 表面摩擦力和幾何形狀相關。在商業生產驗證（PPQ）前應充分評估。
blocks.en: Twinning: two stoppers lock together while being sorted in the vibratory bowl, interrupting feeding and stopping the machine. How often it occurs depends on the stopper's surface friction and geometry. It should be thoroughly evaluated before commercial process performance qualification (PPQ).

blocks.zh: RTU vs. 自處理的決策框架
blocks.en: Decision Framework: RTU vs. Self-processing

blocks.zh:
RTU Stoppers:
  + 省去清洗/矽化/滅菌步驟
  + 減少操作員介入（無菌保證 #1）
  + 供應商持有批次紀錄
  - 成本較高
  - 供應商依賴（商業彈性 #3）

In-house Processing:
  + 成本較低（大批次）
  + 自主掌控製程參數
  - 需額外設備與驗證
  - 更多製程步驟 = 更多污染風險
blocks.en:
RTU Stoppers:
  + No washing/siliconization/sterilization steps
  + Less operator intervention (sterility assurance #1)
  + Supplier holds the batch records
  - Higher cost
  - Supplier dependence (commercial flexibility #3)

In-house Processing:
  + Lower cost (large batches)
  + Own control of process parameters
  - Extra equipment and validation required
  - More process steps = more contamination risk

blocks.zh: 小瓶與玻璃瓶的彈性體插入技術（p121-p122）
blocks.en: Elastomer Insertion Technologies for Vials and Glass Bottles (p121-p122)

blocks.zh: 小瓶塞入的三個步驟
blocks.en: The Three Steps of Vial Stoppering

blocks.zh: 定向（Orientation）：Finial/flange 朝上，shank 朝下 — 振動碗負責排向
blocks.en: Orientation: finial/flange up, shank down - the vibratory bowl handles the orientation

blocks.zh: 放置（Placement）：真空傳送 / 機械傳送 / 摩擦傳送將 stopper 放到瓶口
blocks.en: Placement: vacuum transfer / mechanical transfer / friction transfer places the stopper on the vial opening

blocks.zh: 壓合（Insertion）：滾輪或真空將 stopper 壓入瓶頸，形成 land seal（接觸密封）
blocks.en: Insertion: rollers or vacuum press the stopper into the vial neck, forming the land seal

blocks.zh: Land seal（接觸密封）：stopper 底部凸緣與瓶口頂面的環形接觸面 — 這是 CCI 的核心。
blocks.en: Land seal: the ring-shaped contact surface between the underside of the stopper flange and the top surface of the vial finish - this is the core of CCI.

blocks.zh: Headspace 控制 — 無菌保證 + CQA 交叉點
blocks.en: Headspace Control - Where Sterility Assurance Meets CQAs

blocks.zh: 壓塞站是 headspace 管理的關鍵點：
blocks.en: The stoppering station is the key point for headspace management:

blocks.zh: 充惰性氣體（N₂ / Ar）：防止氧化敏感產品降解（CQA #2）
blocks.en: Inert gas overlay (N₂ / Ar): prevents degradation of oxidation-sensitive products (CQA #2)

blocks.zh: 抽真空：減少殘留空氣，改善後續目視檢查的可見度（商業 #3）
blocks.en: Vacuum: reduces residual air and improves visibility in subsequent visual inspection (commercial #3)

blocks.zh: 凍乾專用：部分插入 → 昇華 → 最終壓合，三段式密封完整性管理
blocks.en: Lyophilization-specific: partial insertion → sublimation → final seating, a three-stage management of seal integrity

blocks.zh: Raised Stopper Detection — 視覺系統整合
blocks.en: Raised Stopper Detection - Vision System Integration

blocks.zh: Raised stopper（塞子高插）：stopper 未完全壓入，在 flange 與瓶口 landing zone 之間留有間隙，導致 CCI 失敗。
blocks.en: Raised stopper: a stopper that is not fully pressed in, leaving a gap between the flange and the landing zone of the vial finish, which results in CCI failure.

blocks.zh: 偵測方式：感應器（高度偵測）或機器視覺（vision system）。配合自動重塞（re-stoppering）功能，可在 Grade A 環境下修正，避免正確灌裝品被廢棄（商業彈性 #3）。
blocks.en: Detection methods: sensors (height detection) or a machine vision system. With an automatic re-stoppering function, the stopper can be corrected in a Grade A environment, avoiding rejection of correctly filled units (commercial flexibility #3).

blocks.zh: 生活比喻：凍乾塞的三段式密封
blocks.en: Everyday Analogy: The Three-Stage Seal of the Lyophilization Stopper

blocks.zh: 想像在戶外晾濕衣服（昇華 = 水分散發），你先把晾衣架架好但不完全關閉，讓空氣流通。衣服乾了之後，再把架子完全合上鎖定。凍乾塞的邏輯完全相同：部分插入（通氣）→ 昇華完成 → 真空充氮 → 棚架壓合（完整密封）。
blocks.en: Imagine drying wet laundry outdoors (sublimation = moisture leaving). You first set up the drying rack but do not close it completely, so air can circulate. Once the clothes are dry, you fold the rack fully shut and lock it. The lyophilization stopper follows exactly the same logic: partial insertion (venting) → sublimation complete → vacuum and nitrogen backfill → shelf stoppering (full seal).

blocks.zh: 預填充注射器與卡匣的彈性體插入技術（p122-p124）
blocks.en: Elastomer Insertion Technologies for Prefilled Syringes and Cartridges (p122-p124)

blocks.zh: 注射器 Stopper 的雙重角色
blocks.en: The Dual Role of the Syringe Stopper

blocks.zh: 小瓶的 stopper 只需要「密封」。但預填充注射器和卡匣的 stopper 同時負責：
blocks.en: A vial stopper only needs to "seal". The stopper of a prefilled syringe or cartridge is responsible for both of the following:

blocks.zh: 保護（Protection）：維持 CCI，防止污染（無菌保證 #1）
blocks.en: Protection: maintains CCI and prevents contamination (sterility assurance #1)

blocks.zh: 遞送（Delivery）：在活塞桿推動下平滑移動，精準送藥（CQA #2）
blocks.en: Delivery: moves smoothly under the plunger rod to deliver the dose accurately (CQA #2)

blocks.zh: 因此，注射器 stopper 的多肋紋（multiple ribs）設計同時服務兩個目的：密封 + 低滑動力。
blocks.en: For this reason the multiple-rib design of a syringe stopper serves two purposes at once: sealing + low glide force.

blocks.zh: 三種插入方法速覽
blocks.en: The Three Insertion Methods at a Glance

blocks.zh: 通氣式插入（Vented）：機械壓入，速度最快，成本最低，但氣泡移除效果較差，不適合無矽化 stopper
blocks.en: Vented insertion: mechanical insertion; the fastest and lowest cost, but poor bubble removal and not suitable for silicone-free stoppers

blocks.zh: 真空插入（Vacuum Bell）：在真空環境下放入，氣泡移除最佳，但精確度較低，成本最高，速度較慢
blocks.en: Vacuum insertion (vacuum bell): the stopper is placed under vacuum; the best bubble removal, but lower accuracy, the highest cost and slower speed

blocks.zh: 真空輔助通氣（Vacuum-Assisted Vented）：結合兩者優點，短管版本適合大填充量/淺插入，長管版本適合小填充量/深插入
blocks.en: Vacuum-assisted vented: combines the advantages of both; the short-tube version suits large fill volumes/shallow insertion, and the long-tube version suits small fill volumes/deep insertion

blocks.zh: 矽化 vs. 無矽化 — 蛋白質產品的關鍵決策
blocks.en: Siliconized vs. Silicone-free - A Key Decision for Protein Products

blocks.zh: 矽油（silicone）塗層可能誘發蛋白質藥物（如抗體、胰島素）發生聚集（aggregation），形成可見或次可見微粒，直接威脅病人安全（CQA #2）。
blocks.en: Silicone oil coatings can induce aggregation of protein drugs (e.g. antibodies, insulin), forming visible or subvisible particles that directly threaten patient safety (CQA #2).

blocks.zh: 因此，高價值生物製劑通常採用：
blocks.en: For this reason, high-value biologics typically use:

blocks.zh: 無矽化彈性體（silicone-free）+ Teflon 塗層
blocks.en: Silicone-free elastomers + Teflon coating

blocks.zh: 搭配真空插入或短管真空輔助通氣法（不適合通氣式）
blocks.en: Combined with vacuum insertion or short-tube vacuum-assisted vented insertion (vented insertion is not suitable)

blocks.zh: 此決策優先級：CQA 安全（#2）> 商業速度（#3）。
blocks.en: Priority of this decision: CQA safety (#2) > commercial speed (#3).

blocks.zh: 1. 為何通氣式插入（Vented）對無矽化 stopper「無效（Not effective）」？從摩擦力與插入機制解釋。
blocks.en: 1. Why is vented insertion "not effective" for silicone-free stoppers? Explain in terms of friction and the insertion mechanism.

blocks.zh: 2. Vacuum Bell 在小填充量（small fill volume）的效果較差，原因為何？
blocks.en: 2. Why is the vacuum bell less effective at small fill volumes?

blocks.zh: 通氣式 vs. 真空式插入技術完整比較（p124）
blocks.en: Full Comparison of Vented vs. Vacuum Insertion Technologies (p124)

blocks.zh: 解析與決策注解
blocks.en: Analysis and Decision Commentary

blocks.zh: 插入方法選擇決策樹
blocks.en: Decision Tree for Selecting the Insertion Method

blocks.zh:
Step 1: 是否為無矽化 stopper？
  YES → 排除 Vented 和 Long-tube VA
        → 選擇 Vacuum Bell 或 Short-tube VA

Step 2: 填充量大小？
  小填充量（<0.5 mL）→ Long-tube VA 或 Vacuum Bell
  大填充量（>1 mL）→ Short-tube VA 或 Vacuum Bell

Step 3: 產品黏度高嗎？
  YES → Vacuum Bell 或 VA 系列（機械式較難均勻覆蓋）

Step 4: 速度 / 產量要求？
  高速（>400 spm）→ 傾向 Vented 或 Short-tube VA
  低速可接受 → Vacuum Bell 亦可考慮
blocks.en:
Step 1: Is it a silicone-free stopper?
  YES → Exclude Vented and Long-tube VA
        → Choose Vacuum Bell or Short-tube VA

Step 2: What is the fill volume?
  Small fill volume (<0.5 mL) → Long-tube VA or Vacuum Bell
  Large fill volume (>1 mL) → Short-tube VA or Vacuum Bell

Step 3: Is the product viscosity high?
  YES → Vacuum Bell or the VA series (mechanical insertion has more difficulty giving uniform coverage)

Step 4: Speed / throughput requirement?
  High speed (>400 spm) → favor Vented or Short-tube VA
  Lower speed acceptable → Vacuum Bell can also be considered

blocks.zh: 氣泡問題 — 目視檢查的痛點
blocks.en: The Bubble Problem - A Pain Point in Visual Inspection

blocks.zh: 注射器 stopper 壓入後若殘留氣泡（air bubble）：
blocks.en: If an air bubble remains after the syringe stopper is inserted:

blocks.zh: 目視檢查時容易被誤判為異物微粒 → 偽陽性廢棄率上升
blocks.en: It is easily mistaken for a foreign particle during visual inspection → higher false-reject rate

blocks.zh: 氣泡體積在溫度變化時膨脹 → 影響劑量準確性（CQA #2）
blocks.en: The bubble volume expands with temperature changes → affects dose accuracy (CQA #2)

blocks.zh: 真空插入系列的核心價值就是解決此問題（無菌保證 #1 間接受益，CQA #2 直接受益）。
blocks.en: The core value of the vacuum insertion family is to solve this problem (sterility assurance #1 benefits indirectly, CQA #2 benefits directly).

blocks.zh: CDMO 應用思考：設備選型策略
blocks.en: CDMO Application Considerations: Equipment Selection Strategy

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，若需同時服務多個客戶的 PFS 產品（不同填充量、不同 stopper 類型），建議設備選型時考量：
blocks.en: In a CDMO environment that must serve PFS products from several customers at once (different fill volumes, different stopper types), consider the following when selecting equipment:

blocks.zh: 優先選 Vacuum-Assisted Vented（短管）：兼顧矽化/部分無矽化、大填充量、中等速度，最具彈性
blocks.en: Give priority to Vacuum-Assisted Vented (short tube): it covers siliconized/some silicone-free stoppers, large fill volumes and medium speed, and is the most flexible

blocks.zh: 若有極小填充量 mAb 產品 + 無矽化需求 → 需評估加裝 Vacuum Bell 模組
blocks.en: For a mAb product with a very small fill volume + a silicone-free requirement → evaluate adding a Vacuum Bell module

blocks.zh: 設備彈性（#3）不得犧牲無菌保證（#1）：每次切換插入方法都需要重新驗證
blocks.en: Equipment flexibility (#3) must not come at the expense of sterility assurance (#1): every change of insertion method requires revalidation

blocks.zh: Section 7A Summary — 本節重點總結
blocks.en: Section 7A Summary - Key Takeaways

blocks.zh: 決策層級回顧
blocks.en: Review of the Decision Hierarchy

blocks.zh: 本節決策層級應用
blocks.en: Applying the Decision Hierarchy in This Section

blocks.zh: 無菌保證（#1）：CCI 是 stopper 選擇的首要驅動；raised stopper detection、凍乾兩段式密封、真空插入去氣泡 — 全部服務此目的
blocks.en: Sterility assurance (#1): CCI is the primary driver of stopper selection; raised stopper detection, the two-stage lyophilization seal, and bubble removal by vacuum insertion all serve this purpose

blocks.zh: 產品 CQAs（#2）：Leachables、矽化/聚集問題、Breakaway/Glide force、氣泡對劑量影響 — 直接影響病人安全
blocks.en: Product CQAs (#2): leachables, siliconization/aggregation issues, breakaway/glide force, and the effect of bubbles on dose - these directly affect patient safety

blocks.zh: 商業彈性（#3）：RTU vs. 自處理、插入方法速度、設備多產品相容性 — 在前兩項確保後才最佳化
blocks.en: Commercial flexibility (#3): RTU vs. self-processing, insertion method speed, and multi-product equipment compatibility - optimize these only after the first two are secured
